intro: The most common reason homeowners in Humble start looking into wet room installation is a bathroom that simply no longer works for them — whether that's a cramped shower cubicle, an ageing bath that's become difficult to use, or a desire to make better use of limited space. A properly installed wet room transforms a standard bathroom into something far more practical and visually striking, and done well, it adds real value to your home. In a village like Humble, where properties range from characterful stone cottages to newer estate homes, the approach to installation varies considerably depending on what you're working with.
localContext: Humble sits in Midlothian, and the housing stock here reflects that mix of Scottish rural and suburban character — you'll find older stone-built properties and period cottages alongside more recent modern estates. Each type presents its own challenges when it comes to wet room installation. Stone-built and older properties often have solid or suspended timber floors that need careful assessment before any waterproofing work begins. Timber floors in particular require additional reinforcement to handle the weight of a tanked, tiled wet room, and any existing moisture issues in older walls need addressing before you seal everything in. Modern estate homes in Humble tend to be more straightforward to work with structurally, though headroom and drainage positioning can still require creative solutions. Humble also sits in a moderately hard water area, which is worth knowing because limescale build-up on frameless glass screens and open shower areas is a real consideration — opting for a quality water-fed squeegee routine or even a scale-reducing shower head filter can help keep your wet room looking its best long-term.
serviceDetail: A wet room installation in Humble follows a clear sequence, though the specifics depend heavily on your existing bathroom and property type. The process begins with a site survey, where the installer assesses floor structure, drainage options, and the condition of existing walls. In older Humble properties, this stage often reveals the need for floor reinforcement or remedial damp work before anything else can progress. Once the prep work is done, the existing bathroom is stripped out completely. The floor is then built up using a sloped former or a screeded gradient to ensure water drains effectively towards the waste — getting this fall right is critical, and it's one of the areas where inexperienced tradespeople tend to cut corners. A multi-layer tanking system is applied to the floor and walls, creating a fully waterproof membrane that protects the structure of your home. After tanking, tiling begins — this is where the bulk of the visible transformation happens. Your choice of tiles, the grout colour, and the position of the drain all come together here. Fixtures like thermostatic shower valves, rainfall heads, and handheld attachments are fitted once tiling is complete. The final stage involves sealing, siliconing, and a thorough check of all drainage before the room is signed off and handed over to you.
pricing: Wet room installation in Humble typically costs between £6,000 and £12,000, depending on the size of the bathroom, the complexity of the structural work required, and your choice of fixtures and tiles. Older stone or timber-floored properties at the higher end of that range, since additional reinforcement and tanking preparation add time and materials. A straightforward conversion in a modern estate home with good access and a concrete floor sits comfortably in the lower-to-mid range. High-end tile choices, bespoke glass screens, or premium thermostatic shower systems can push costs toward the upper end regardless of property type. Always get a detailed, itemised quote.
whyLocal: Choosing a tradesperson familiar with Humble and the surrounding Midlothian area genuinely matters for a job like this. Local installers will have worked in the types of properties found here — they'll know what to expect when they lift floorboards in an older stone cottage, and they'll have relationships with local suppliers which can help if materials need to be sourced quickly mid-project. They're also easier to hold accountable. A local professional has a reputation to maintain in the area, which tends to produce better workmanship and more straightforward aftercare if anything needs attention once the job is done.

faqs.q: Can a wet room be installed in an older stone cottage in Humble?
faqs.a: Yes, absolutely — but it requires more preparation than a modern home. Stone-built properties in Humble often have solid floors or suspended timber floors that need reinforcing, and older walls may need treating for damp before tanking. A good installer will identify these issues during a survey and factor them into the quote rather than discovering them mid-job.

faqs.q: How long does wet room installation take in Humble?
faqs.a: Most wet room installations in Humble take between five and ten working days, depending on the size of the room and any remedial structural work needed. Older properties often take longer due to prep work. You'll typically be without a functioning bathroom for most of that time, so it's worth arranging alternative washing facilities in advance.

faqs.q: Will limescale be a problem in a wet room given Humble's water supply?
faqs.a: Humble is in a moderately hard water area, so limescale build-up on tiles, glass, and fittings is something to be aware of. It's manageable with the right habits — a daily squeegee of glass screens, a good bathroom spray, and possibly a scale-reducing shower head filter all help. It's also worth choosing grout and sealant products rated for harder water conditions.

faqs.q: Does a wet room add value to a property in Humble?
faqs.a: A well-installed wet room generally adds value, particularly in Humble's mix of period and modern homes where buyers appreciate quality upgrades. The key word is 'well-installed' — poor waterproofing or amateur tiling can actually cause problems that put buyers off. A properly tanked, professionally finished wet room is a genuine selling point, especially if it replaces an outdated or impractical bathroom.
